haboob.type_zh: 龙裔 幻术师 行动·光环
haboob.text_zh:
再动
在每个回合开始时，在此牌上放置一个风暴指示物，然后除非你为其上的每个风暴指示物摧毁你控制的一个灰烬，否则摧毁它。
攻击行动牌在攻击或防御时获得-1力量。
haboob.text_en:
Go again
At the start of each turn, put a storm counter on this, then destroy it unless you destroy an ash you control for each storm counter on it.
Attack action cards get -1{p} while attacking or defending.

你本回合的下一次攻击获得+2力量。
本回合你下一次命中英雄时，摧毁该英雄拥有的一个费用小于或等于以此方式造成的伤害的非衍生物光环。
再动

Your next attack this turn gets +2{p}.
The next time you hit a hero this turn, destroy a non-token aura they own with cost less than or equal to the damage dealt this way.
Go again

当你推进一个攻击时，摧毁此牌。若如此做，该攻击获得+X力量，X为此牌上的蒸汽指示物数量。

Crank
This enters the arena with 4 steam counters. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it.
When you boost an attack, destroy this. If you do, the attack gets +X{p}, where X is the number of steam counters on this.

hala.text_en: Action - {r}{r}{r}, {t}: Sharpen target sword you control. Go again

While Hala is face down in arsenal, at the start of your turn, you may turn her face up.
While Hala is face up in arsenal, whenever a sword attack you control hits, it gains go again and put a lesson counter on Hala. Then if there are 2 or more lesson counters on Hala, banish her, search your deck for Glistening Steelblade, put it face up in arsenal, and shuffle.

hulk_up.text_en: If you have less {h} than each other hero, this costs {r} less to play.

humble.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄失去所有英雄牌异能，直到其下一个回合结束。
humble.text_en: When this hits a hero, they lose all hero card abilities until the end of their next turn.

humble_entrance.text_zh:
创造3个坚韧衍生物。
再动

hummingbird_call_of_adventure.text_zh:
在你的回合开始时，选择其一；
- 每位英雄创造一个加速衍生物。
- 每位英雄抽一张牌。
- 每位英雄获得1点生命。
hummingbird_call_of_adventure.text_en:
At the start of your turn, choose 1;
- Each hero creates a Quicken token.
- Each hero draws a card.
- Each hero gains 1{h}.

hundred_winds.text_zh:
连击——若百风是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，本战斗链中你每控制一张另一张名为百风的牌，此攻击获得+1力量。
再动
hundred_winds.text_en:
Combo - If Hundred Winds was the last attack this combat chain, this attack gains +1{p} for each other card named Hundred Winds you control on this combat chain.
Go again

hungering_demigon.text_zh:
若一位对手英雄的灵魂中有1张或更多牌，你可以从你的放逐区使用此牌。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其灵魂中的一张牌。
血债
hungering_demigon.text_en:
If an opposing hero has 1 or more cards in their soul, you may play this from your banished zone.
When this hits a hero, banish a card from their soul.
Blood Debt

hungering_slaughterbeast.type_zh: 暗影 蛮将 行动·攻击
hungering_slaughterbeast.text_zh:
作为使用饥饿屠戮兽的额外费用，随机放逐你坟场中的3张牌。
血债
hungering_slaughterbeast.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Hungering Slaughterbeast, banish 3 random cards from your graveyard.
Blood Debt

hungry_for_more.text_zh:
悬念
当此牌离开竞技场时，获得3点生命。
hungry_for_more.text_en:
Suspense
When this leaves the arena, gain 3{h}.

hunt_a_killer.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次匕首攻击获得+4力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。”
再动
hunt_a_killer.text_en:
Your next dagger attack this turn gets +4{p} and "When this hits a hero, mark them."
Go again

hunt_the_hunter.text_zh: 当此牌攻击英雄时，若本回合你使用过另一张红色牌，标记该英雄。
hunt_the_hunter.text_en: When this attacks a hero, if you've played another red card this turn, mark them.

hunt_to_the_ends_of_rathe.name_en: Hunt to the Ends of Rathe
hunt_to_the_ends_of_rathe.text_zh:
当此牌攻击阿拉克尼时，标记该英雄。
若此牌正在攻击被标记的英雄，此牌获得+2力量。
再动
hunt_to_the_ends_of_rathe.text_en:
When this attacks Arakni, mark them.
If this is attacking a marked hero, this gets +2{p}.
Go again

hunted_or_hunter.type_zh: 刺客 防御反应·陷阱
hunted_or_hunter.text_zh: 当此牌防御且攻击英雄在此链环中使用或启动过攻击反应时，该英雄失去1点生命。
hunted_or_hunter.text_en: When this defends and the attacking hero has played or activated an attack reaction this chain link, they lose 1{h}.

hunter_or_hunted.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，说出一张牌名。攻击英雄展示其牌库顶的一张牌。若其为被说出的牌，放逐它，搜寻其手牌、牌库和军械库中至多3张具有该名称的牌并放逐它们，然后该英雄洗牌。
契约——当此牌防御时，你受契约束缚以放逐对手的具有所选名称的牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
hunter_or_hunted.text_en:
When this defends, name a card. The attacking hero reveals the top card of their deck. If it's the named card, banish it, search their hand, deck, and arsenal for up to 3 cards with that name and banish them, then they shuffle.
Contract - While this is defending, you are contracted to banish opponents' cards with the chosen name. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.

hunters_klaive.type_zh: 刺客 武器·匕首 （单手）
hunters_klaive.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。
穿透1
hunters_klaive.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
When this hits a hero, mark them.
Piercing 1

hunts_end.type_zh: 龙裔 战士 攻击反应
hunts_end.text_zh:
仅当你控制3个或更多效忠衍生物时才能使用此牌。
目标匕首攻击获得+4力量。
hunts_end.text_en:
Play this only if you control 3 or more Fealty tokens.
Target dagger attack gets +4{p}.

hurl.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 行动·攻击
hurl.text_zh:
作为使用投掷的额外费用，你可以支付1点资源。当你如此做时，它获得“当此牌攻击时，你控制的目标匕首对目标英雄造成1点伤害。若以此方式造成伤害，该匕首视为命中。摧毁该匕首。”
再动
hurl.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Hurl, you may pay {r}. When you do, it gains "When this attacks, target dagger you control deals 1 damage to target hero. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit. Destroy the dagger."
Go again

hurricane_technique.text_zh: 连击——若升膝突是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，飓风技法获得+1力量、再动，以及“若飓风技法命中，将其置入你的手牌。”
hurricane_technique.text_en: Combo - If Rising Knee Thrust was the last attack this combat chain, Hurricane Technique gains +1{p}, go again, and "If Hurricane Technique hits, put it into your hand."

hydraulic_press.text_zh:
废铁
当此牌攻击时，若它废掉过一张牌，此牌获得压制。
hydraulic_press.text_en:
Scrap
When this attacks, if it scrapped a card, this gets overpower.

hyper_driver.text_zh:
此牌进入竞技场时带有3个蒸汽指示物。当其用完时，摧毁它。
每回合一次，当你推进一张牌时，从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物并获得1点资源。
hyper_driver.text_en:
This enters the arena with 3 steam counters. When it has none, destroy it.
Once per turn, when you boost a card, remove a steam counter from this and gain {r}.

hyper_inflation.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，本回合牌的使用费用增加1点资源。
再动
hyper_inflation.text_en:
When this attacks, cards cost {r} more to play this turn.
Go again

hyper_scrapper.text_zh:
作为使用此牌的额外费用，放逐你坟场中的X个物品。
当此牌攻击时，它获得+X力量。若为使用此牌放逐了3张或更多超频驱动器，获得6点资源，此牌获得再动。
hyper_scrapper.text_en:
As an additional cost to play this, banish X items from your graveyard.
When this attacks it gets +X{p}. If 3 or more Hyper Drivers were banished to play this, gain {r}{r}{r} {r}{r}{r} and this gets go again.

hyper_x3.text_zh:
每当你因推进放逐一张超频驱动器时，将其置于此牌之下。
每回合一次，当一张超频驱动器被置于此牌之下时，若此牌之下有3张或更多超频驱动器，抽一张牌。
战痕
hyper_x3.text_en:
Whenever you banish a Hyper Driver from boosting, put it under this.
Once per turn, when a Hyper Driver is put under this, if there are 3 or more Hyper Drivers under this, draw a card.
Battleworn

hypothermia.text_zh:
你控制的攻击不能获得再动。
在你的结束阶段开始时，摧毁体温过低。
hypothermia.text_en:
Attacks you control can't gain go again.
At the beginning of your end phase, destroy Hypothermia.
